evaluations.evidence: create a new game
evaluations.rationale: Creation of games is present and complementary capabilities (invite, start round, delete, browse, export) exist in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: invite estimators
evaluations.rationale: Inviting estimators is supported and matched by joining (PP-029) and invite limits (PP-028).

evaluations.evidence: start a round
evaluations.rationale: Starting a round is supported alongside item management (add/edit/delete/select) and estimation features.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we try to estimate
evaluations.rationale: Story list viewing complements item creation, editing, deletion stories (PP-006, PP-007, PP-008).

evaluations.evidence: select an item to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Selection is supported with item lifecycle stories present (add/edit/delete).

evaluations.evidence: add an item to the list
evaluations.rationale: Addition of items is present and paired with edit/delete/select and display features.

evaluations.evidence: edit an item in the list
evaluations.rationale: Editing items is complemented by creation (PP-006) and deletion (PP-008).

evaluations.evidence: delete an item from the list
evaluations.rationale: Deletion references existing items but creation and listing capabilities are present (PP-006, PP-004).

evaluations.evidence: show all estimates immediately
evaluations.rationale: Feature to reveal estimates early is self-contained and complements estimate-gathering behavior.

evaluations.evidence: accept the average of all estimates
evaluations.rationale: Accepting an average complements estimate display and agreement workflows; necessary estimate collection stories exist.

evaluations.evidence: "estimate" field filled in automatically
evaluations.rationale: Auto-fill behavior is an enhancement of estimate handling; core estimate collection is covered elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: enter the agreed-upon estimate
evaluations.rationale: Recording agreed estimate complements display and acceptance stories and is otherwise self-contained.

evaluations.evidence: estimate a story we estimated earlier
evaluations.rationale: Re-estimation relies on stored history and navigation features (PP-039, PP-017) present in backlog.

evaluations.evidence: import stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Importing stories is complementary to story management features (add/edit/delete) and no dependent capability is missing.

evaluations.evidence: copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Bulk paste complements other story input methods; no missing complementary capability is evident.

evaluations.evidence: browse through previous games
evaluations.rationale: Browsing previous games is supported by viewing/exporting transcripts and game deletion; necessary read capabilities exist.

evaluations.evidence: view a transcript of a game
evaluations.rationale: Viewing transcripts is coherent with browsing/exporting and with game creation/persistence stories.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript as a HTML file
evaluations.rationale: Export capability complements transcript viewing (PP-017); no missing complement is evident.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript as a CSV file
evaluations.rationale: CSV export complements transcript storage and analysis features; required transcript data exists.

evaluations.evidence: delete a game
evaluations.rationale: Game deletion references stored games but creation and listing features are present (PP-001, PP-016).

evaluations.evidence: create an account
evaluations.rationale: Account creation is present; related account lifecycle stories (login, change, delete, password reminder) also exist.

evaluations.evidence: log in using my account name and password
evaluations.rationale: Login complements account creation (PP-021) and password reminder (PP-026); no missing complementary capability found.

evaluations.evidence: change my account details
evaluations.rationale: Changing account details complements create/login/delete account stories; the backlog contains the account lifecycle.

evaluations.evidence: delete my account
evaluations.rationale: Account deletion is supported and balanced by account creation and related account management stories.

evaluations.evidence: see dates and times in my local timezone
evaluations.rationale: Timezone display is a self-contained presentation requirement; no missing complementary capability is required.

evaluations.evidence: get a password reminder by email
evaluations.rationale: Password reminder is supported by account creation capturing email (PP-021); requisite data and flow are present.

evaluations.evidence: select whether to have the team estimate with ...
evaluations.rationale: Deck selection is self-contained and does not expose missing complementary capabilities.

evaluations.evidence: invite up to 15 estimators
evaluations.rationale: Invite limit complements invitation and join stories (PP-002, PP-029); required join capability exists.

evaluations.evidence: join a game by entering my name
evaluations.rationale: Join is matched with invitation (PP-002) and estimator-related display stories; no missing complement detected.

evaluations.evidence: see the item we're estimating
evaluations.rationale: Displaying the current item is supported by item selection and listing stories; no required complement is missing.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we will try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Session item overview complements item creation and navigation; necessary capabilities are present.

evaluations.evidence: immediately see that an estimate has been given by a specific estimator
evaluations.rationale: Estimator presence indicators are supported by join (PP-029) and estimate display stories (PP-033); no missing complement found.

evaluations.evidence: shown all estimates at the same time after all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: Simultaneous reveal is consistent with estimate collection and display stories; complementary pieces exist.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate up until the last person selects a card
evaluations.rationale: Ability to change estimate is supported by estimate collection and reveal mechanics; no missing complementary capability is evident.

evaluations.evidence: see each estimator's prior estimates for the story being estimated
evaluations.rationale: Viewing prior estimates relies on stored history and navigation features (PP-039, PP-017), which are present.

evaluations.evidence: see who gave what estimates during the current round
evaluations.rationale: Attribution of estimates is supported by join and display stories; no missing complementary capability detected.

evaluations.evidence: start a two-minute countdown timer that all participants can see
evaluations.rationale: Shared timer feature is self-contained; the backlog includes related timer reset behavior (PP-038).

evaluations.evidence: two-minute timer reset itself as soon as we all play an estimate
evaluations.rationale: Timer reset complements timer start and estimate collection; required triggers are present in other stories.

evaluations.evidence: scroll back through the stories and estimates from prior rounds
evaluations.rationale: Historical navigation exists alongside transcript and browse features (PP-017, PP-016); no complementary capability missing.

evaluations.evidence: always have the cards in the same order across multiple draws
evaluations.rationale: Consistent card ordering is a presentation requirement and does not expose a missing complementary story.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed
evaluations.rationale: Estimate change is supported by other estimate lifecycle stories; necessary complementary behaviors are present.

evaluations.evidence: have a small thumbnail photo displayed
evaluations.rationale: Displaying a thumbnail photo requires a complementary capability to provide/upload or manage that photo; the backlog contains no explicit story to upload/set user photos (account creation PP-021 and change details PP-023 do not explicitly include avatar/photo management).

evaluations.evidence: compliant with XHTML and CSS standards
evaluations.rationale: Standards compliance is a non-functional requirement and does not expose a missing complementary functional capability in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: have a list of definitions for commonly used terms
evaluations.rationale: Glossary requirement is self-contained; no missing complementary capability is required for completeness.

evaluations.evidence: created database indexes
evaluations.rationale: Performance-related developer story is an implementation detail and does not indicate a missing functional capability.

evaluations.evidence: function correctly in Internet Explorer ... Firefox ... Safari ...
evaluations.rationale: Browser compatibility is non-functional; it does not expose missing functional complements in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: site comply with the W3C accessibility guidelines
evaluations.rationale: Accessibility compliance is non-functional and self-contained; no missing complementary functional story is required.

evaluations.evidence: application respond quickly to my actions
evaluations.rationale: Performance requirement complements developer stories (PP-045) and does not reveal a missing functional capability.

evaluations.evidence: be able to use Unicode
evaluations.rationale: Unicode support is a technical/internationalization requirement and doesn't imply a missing complementary story.

evaluations.evidence: see sensible and predictable URLs
evaluations.rationale: URL design is a presentation/UX requirement and does not expose a missing functional complement.

evaluations.evidence: have nice error pages
evaluations.rationale: Error page UX is self-contained and does not reveal a missing complementary functional capability.

evaluations.evidence: results to be stored in a non-identifiable way
evaluations.rationale: Data anonymization/storage requirement is explicit; it does not require an additional complementary story to be implementable.

evaluations.evidence: see some metrics on use of the game
evaluations.rationale: Metrics story stands alone and is compatible with stored transcripts and browsing features; no essential complement is missing.
